title: Good-Faith Payments and the Charged-Off Settlement Plan Percentage
content:
**Rule.** For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a loan with at least two payments posted in the six calendar months before the decision date and no payment return recorded in those six months earns 6 points; a loan whose payments posted in those six months outnumber the payment returns recorded in them, with at least one return recorded in them, earns 3 points; any other loan earns none, a payment or return dated exactly six months before the decision date falling outside those months. Payments and returns of any kind on the loan's Personal Loans payment ledger are counted. Each point is one percentage point off the settlement percentage.

## Truth table (counts within the six months)

| Payments posted | Returns recorded | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0 | 6 |
| more than the returns | 1 or more | 3 |
| 0 or 1 | 0 | none |
| equal to or fewer than the returns | 1 or more | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- 3 payments posted, 1 return: payments outnumber returns with a return recorded, 3 points.
- 2 payments posted, 2 returns: payments do not outnumber returns, none.
- 1 payment posted, no return: fewer than two payments, none.
- Decision date 20 October: a payment dated 20 April is exactly six months back and outside the months; one dated 21 April is inside.
